parts.text: Which claim correctly classifies this change?

options.text: It is a physical change, because the rock stays the same substance.
It is a chemical change, because no new substance forms.
It is a chemical change, because frost is a natural force.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem:
Kabir watches frost crack a boulder into smaller pieces of the same rock material. No new substance forms.

Answer both parts.

part_answers.answer: Breaking into smaller pieces of the same rock with no new substance is a physical change.

teacher.key_rationale: The new-substance test decides physical vs chemical: frost splits the boulder but the material stays the same rock, so the change is physical.
